Services
The Producers Livestock Service Model
Our business sectors are equipped to help you with the decisions that matter most on your operation.
Marketing
When it comes to buying and selling cattle or hogs, we believe the best transaction is a win-win-win. This means a competitive market price for the seller, the best value for the buyer and reasonable terms and conditions to complete the sale. Our goal is to maximize the value of cattle and hogs for all parties with every transaction.
Learn About Marketing Services
Credit
Feeding livestock is a capital intensive venture. That’s why Producers Livestock offers financing options to help cattle and hog producers manage their cash flow until the animals are marketed. We work in partnership with banks across our territory to provide specialized livestock financing to customers and are a trusted resource to farmers for additional funding.
Learn About Financing Options
Commodities
Having a broker who truly understands the industry can be the difference in profit or loss for your grain and livestock operation. We are able to trade any and all commodities to fit your trading and hedging needs, while staying true to our specialty of live cattle, feeder cattle, lean hogs, corn and soybeans.
Learn About Risk Management Tools
Who We Work With
Cattle & Hog Producers
We provide marketing support, risk management tools and financing for livestock and/or feed.
Packers & Processors
We help with cattle and hog procurement to get the right animal at the right price for your processing needs.
Private Lending Institutions
We offer financing as a secondary lender to help support your customers and keep their operations moving forward.
Why Producers Livestock?
When you work with Producers Livestock, you have a trusted partner . We know each operation is different, and we make sure you have the support and resources you need to make profitable decisions .
Learn About Producers
Who we are
Producers Livestock offers livestock sourcing and marketing, commodities trading and hedging and loans and credit facilities to farmers and processors in the Midwestern U.S. and Central Plains.
